title: Membership in the binary support
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\gamma$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the two-element field, and let $i\text{Fin}(n)$. Then $i$ belongs to the support of $\gamma$ exactly when $\gamma(i)$ is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: Function $\gamma$ from the binary cube of dimension $n$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$
